agentUtterance.text:
Each MFA verification code can only be entered 5 times before it expires. If you reach your resend limit, you can click "try another method" and select an alternative method to receive your code.

I'll send a text to the device you're calling from. If you have any additional questions about Multi-Factor Authentication, the page has all the information you need. Is that alright?

inputActionParameters.sms_content: You can visit bell.ca/mybellmfa to learn more about multi-factor authentication (MFA).

playbookInput.precedingConversationSummary: The user wants to login to their account.

actionParameters.utterance: My MFA is not working. Can you assist me?

playbookOutput.executionSummary: The user is an "Existing" Customer and has a {mfa} then prompts the user with an appropriate response. If the customer agrees to receive the SMS link and send the user to bell_SMS Trigger flow.
